title: ui(i18n): console reads the `preflight.fields.{path}` bundle labels in the param dialog (useObjectLabel.actionPreflight, after #31885 and #31808)
body:
domain:spec#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUe9c6YdtNkrzUnMUd

Filing gate: ④, a per-layer child of a coordination card. This is the console half of #31885's translation key. The contract review of PR #31924 (record 6740632004, ③ escalation) found that no card owns it. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #31885, #31808

- **Business reason:** #31885 lets a bundle translate a preflight row label (`_actions.NAME.preflight.fields.PATH`), so that a zh or ja user sees localized row labels in the param dialog's server read. Once #31885 and #31808 land as drafted, though, the key is read only by the REST seam (`translateAction` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`). No console code reads it, so the dialog keeps showing the untranslated labels and the business reason stays open.
- **Why the console needs its own read:** the console translates the result dialog on the client, not through the REST seam. `useObjectLabel().actionResultDialog` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` L694) is called from `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` L250 and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` L1496. PR #31933 (the console half of #31808) hands the preflight block to those same two handlers, but adds no `actionPreflight` mirror; it only calls `pickLocalized` on inline label maps.
- **What to build,** from the merged spec rather than from this card:
  - a `useObjectLabel().actionPreflight` mirror of `actionResultDialog`, which overlays the bundle's `preflight.fields.PATH` strings on declared `fields[]` rows only, with the literal path as one key;
  - wiring at both call sites;
  - the same keys under `globalActions.NAME`.
- **Reader:** the `domain:ui` lane, after both blockers merge. If the ui seat would rather fold this into #31808 / PR #31933 before it lands, close this card as a duplicate and record that on #31808.
- **Dedupe (open and closed):** searching `actionPreflight` and `preflight` returns #31840, #31808, #31860, #31885 and #31925. None of them carries the console read of the bundle key; #31925 is the skills teaching only.
